title: FLEXISPOT H7 Adjustable Overbed Bedside Table with Wheels Pneumatic Mobile Standing Desk Laptop Desk Rolling Computer Cart Movable Overbed Table Hospital Home Use(31.5" W x 17.7" D, Black Maple Large)

reviews.title: Fantastic Bedside Table!!!
reviews.body: I think think think that this is a great addition for anyone looking for extra movable space. There are also many color options to choose from to match almost any room that you have. The gas powered lifting mechanism helps make it easy to lift the tabletop when you need do change the height. I think something like this is very versatile to have since you can use it in the bathroom, next to your desk, over the bed, and over a walking pad. It's because of the design of the table where it's like an overhang and the bottom can side under objects like a bed really easily. The hidden casters make it really easy to move around so like you can basically have a table anywhere. There's also a cup holder that makes it easy to have drinks around on the desk without it taking extra space. The table barely flexes with weight on it so its pretty sturdy. For thr price, I can easily recommend it to anyone since it's pretty good value for the money. Overall it was really easy to use and put together.

reviews.title: Great value! Quick and easy build; very sturdy. 10/10 Would buy again.
reviews.body: Super quico to put together! Assembled in roughly 20-30 minutes and it feels sooo sturdy. Had to come here and leave a review because im very please with it so far. For its quality, easy build and space saving style, its a fantastic value for the money. I love that i can adjust the height to fit both over my very tall bed with enough room for me to sit comfortably beneath it and be anle to bring it down super low for my very low couch. Its tall enough for me to use when standing (Im 5' 3" for reference) and still was able to go much higher. My boyfriend who is 5'10" is able to use it standing up comfortably.

reviews.title: Good for the price.
reviews.body: It's worth the price but don't think it's worthy of 5 stars. Overall looks good, it's functional and I'm keeping it. The reasons for my less than enthusiast endorsement: 1.) It's sturdy enough but not super sturdy. Not bad, but a bit wobbly when you are rolling it or it gets bumped. I have hard floors and it rolls fine, but I doubt it would roll easily on carpet. 2.) The top is super slick. Things like plates and my TV remote slide around like an air hockey table. I had some rubbery shelf paper that I used to fix that. I love the cup holder though. 3.) The table raises up easily enough but lowering it is a bit more tricky. You have to actuate a lever and push down in a specific area of the table, and it's not easy to do from a lying down position. While standing up, the leverage is much better and it's easy. I think it could be difficult for someone who is injured, elderly or has their mobility impaired. Bottom line, if you're purchasing it for light, occasional use, or maybe for short term convalescing, it's a nice little table at a fair price. If you are using it frequently or for long term care of a bedridden person, you may want to spend a little more and get something a little more robust.
reviews.author: AEE33LZ6MLBUHXKRUZKLLUUHJTFA

reviews.title: Exactly What I Was Looking For! - The first time I ordered.
reviews.body: EDIT : I came back to edit my review after receiving the second table and am now very disappointed. I should have looked closer before ordering but they have completely changed how these tables are made. Even the lever to lower and lift the table is a cheap feeling and looking plastic. It feels very cheaply made, it wobbles, and the table top feels like it could snap in half if too much pressure is put on it. So the idea of putting a heavy 32” curved monitor on this, worry’s me. There’s no way I’m risking screwing in an under desk Xbox mount either. The base is completely different as well, longer, wider, taller and over all does not seem as sturdy as what it was a few months ago. And with it being larger, it makes it more difficult to fit in smaller spaces under different types of furniture. There is also a slight tilt on the table that it doesn’t look like it sits flat as the old version does. Now I know people can come and say, well you didn’t put it together properly. Yes I did. I used a screw gun and made sure every piece was snug. But because of that, when screwing the table top, I could start to hear the wood crack when tightening the screw, which did not happen at all on the old version and the screw wasn’t even tight yet as it wasn’t sitting flush with the metal. I’m not sure what happened, but go back to the old design please. I’ll most likely return this one in the hopes I can find something different again. So sad and so disappointed. (I’ve included a new video of the new table and the old one to show for example.) I never write good reviews but had to give props to this one. I bought this for my partner a few months ago and I just now ordered myself one. I turned it into a little gaming desk so we can sit and play on our computers or our Xbox while watching TV. Now we don’t like sharing it so hence why I got the second one. I did initially put the cupholder on, however I ended up taking it off as we would be using it while our chairs are reclined which gave us extra leg room. And we never really used it since we are using these in our living room. It fits and holds well, a 32” monitor - curved. So you know there’s some weight to it. I will say because we have monitors on it, we do roll it carefully. But I’ve never had a worry on it tipping and it never tilts. Sits flat as a board! It’s really well made and I was even able to customize it by adding some xbox desk mounts to the bottom of it to hold an xbox and still be able to put all the plugs in, as well as lift and lower the desk as needed. Absolutely LOVE it!!! Worth every penny!!
reviews.author: AFUENL5SGFZ5UO6OGLX6ZI45POBA

reviews.title: Great portable desk that gets me out of my home office
reviews.body: Customer Service ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ My desk went missing during shipment, and was sitting at a FedEx hub for several days without movement, so I contacted FlexiSpot. They were awesome! They responded quickly, asked if I wanted a refund, or a replacement. I chose to have a replacement. They shipped it out the next business day, and messaged me to provide the new tracking information. The replacement desk arrived within 2 days. Amazing customer service! I bought the large table with maple top. It was fairly easy for me to put together. It’s low profile enough that it can slide under a low sofa or other furniture. The cup holder is made of strong plastic, and holds a larger sized water bottle. It came with a nice screw driver just to attach the cup holder with, so that was great. The cup holder could easily be left off, if not needed. I work remote, and I bought this so I could work from my screened in porch on days when it’s nice outside. It has enough space on top for my laptop, mouse pad, and a portable monitor. I have only used it from a sitting position, but it raises easily. Lowering it is a little difficult because you have to pull up on the lever, while also pushing on the desk downward to force it down. Might be difficult to lower if the desk has a lot of equipment on top, but it’s not a dealbreaker. I leave it on the screened porch as a side table for my outdoor couch when I’m not using it as a desk. I appreciate the convenience of this portable adjustable height desk.
reviews.author: AFZZCP5AAYMGQKDZ7CE6O46RUYLQ
